subject.title: Add auth sync command or auto-sync for API key rotation across agents

question: Should OpenClaw resolve API-key rotation shadowing with an operator-controlled auth repair/warning flow, automatic cross-agent sync, or runtime fallback from stale profiles to updated env/config credentials?
rationale: Each viable fix changes credential propagation, provider precedence, or failure recovery semantics across agent stores, and repository policy treats those surfaces as security- and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Operator-controlled repair and warnings
options.body: Add an explicit CLI, doctor, or status path that detects shadowed provider credentials and updates canonical SQLite auth stores only after user intent.

options.title: Automatic sync on config change or reload
options.body: Propagate matching config/env key updates into agent auth stores automatically, accepting the wider implicit credential-copying behavior after security review.

options.title: Runtime fallback after auth failure
options.body: Try env/config credentials after a stored profile fails, accepting a precedence change that may mask stale state and alter provider failover behavior.

recommendation.title: Operator-controlled repair and warnings
recommendation.body: Add an explicit CLI, doctor, or status path that detects shadowed provider credentials and updates canonical SQLite auth stores only after user intent.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice centers on the model-auth and auth-store precedence paths where recent history points most strongly to this owner.
